Name: Time Bank Scythe
Author: nastapolka
Description:
[size=4]Are you feeling overwhelmed by the amount of things you have to do each day in Stardew Valley?
Do you wish you had an alternative to conventional time stop mods because those completely kill your enjoyment?
Do you wish you were rewarded for going to bed early instead of having to do stuff until 2am to get the most out of a day?
If so, this mod may be for you!


[u][b]How this works[/b][/u]
- Going to bed adds the time until 2am to your stored time.
﻿e.g. Going to bed at 1:30am adds 30 minutes to the bank.
- Time stored is displayed in the tooltip for any scythe.
﻿(Scythes added by mods [i]should [/i]work too.)
- Right-click while holding a scythe to stop time.
﻿Every time the clock should advance 10 minutes, 10 minutes are deducted from the stored time instead.
- While time is stopped, machines (furnaces, etc) continue running and locations continue updating.
- Time resumes when right-clicking again with a scythe, or when stored time runs out, or when waking up in the morning.


[b][u]Config options[/u][/b]
If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is installed, you can choose to disable the following two indicators that time is stopped:
- the HUD message in the bottom left
- the shaking of the in-game clock once per second


[b][u]Minor incompatibility[/u][/b]
- Stopping time with this mod, then winding back time with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats Menu[/url] can cause time to go earlier than 6am.
﻿(It can even go negative!)
﻿Doesn't make the farmer collapse or have any negative effects though.
[/size][size=4]




[/size]
